notes: WorldServer.func_147452_c queues a block event (deduped) and func_147488_Z, in the next world tick, applies it on the server block (onBlockEventReceived) and sends the S24 only when that answers true. The reachable senders: the chest and ender chest lid counters (event 1, the players-using count; the server's own receiveClientEvent sets the same count and answers true), the note block (its client half is a sound and a note particle, which agent mode's minimal particle setting never makes), pistons (redstone off). MobSpawnerBaseLogic.resetTimer's event 1 never goes out: the server's receiveClientEvent answers false (setDelayToMin acts on a client world only), so a client spawner's delay only counts down (play.c tileents_tick, checked by idx-spawner-s1). The client half: the chest's client tile entity steps its lid on the S24's count, which reaches it at the second client tick after the server's open or close, so the client's lid and previous lid are the server's of one row before (play.c chest_lids_after_row); idx-clientview-s1's clientview.jsonl holds the live client's lids to the oracle client's at every frame (the open at row 185 fails with the server's lids drawn). idxaudit 2026-09-27: dropped evidence that runs none of this file's code (JaCoCo): idx-spawner-s1.
